links.comparator_used: Head-to-head comparison of alternative XAI methods (LIME variants, GradCAM, GradCAM++, SHAP) on the same CNN predictions, assessed by technical metrics (IoU/Dice vs pathologist annotations; AOPC and insertion/deletion AUC). No clinician reader study.
links.outcome: Spatial agreement with pathologist annotations and faithfulness of explanations
links.effect: GradCAM++ highest spatial agreement (mean IoU = 0.52 ± 0.14 for EfficientNetB3); SHAP highest faithfulness (AOPC = 0.61 ± 0.08); squaregrid LIME IoU = 0.44 ± 0.17; method rankings preserved across binarisation thresholds
links.tradeoff: Squaregrid LIME had 3.8× lower computational cost than LIME AVG and no parameters to tune. No clinician accuracy, understanding or workload outcomes were tested, and no prospective or multi-site validation was done.
links.quote: GradCAM++ achieved the highest spatial agreement with pathologist annotations (mean IoU = 0.52 ± 0.14 for EfficientNetB3), while SHAP yielded the highest faithfulness scores (AOPC = 0.61 ± 0.08).

design_hint: explainability (XAI) method selection for pathology AI
